title: Get Shop Video Product Performance List
breadcrumb: Get Shop Video Product Performance List
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/products/performance

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns performance metrics for a list of products promoted in a given video.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
video_id string Y 752xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx42 The ID of the shop video whose promoted product performance list is requested.

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
end_date_lt string Y 2024-09-08 End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone. It must be later than start_date_ge.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)
page_size int N 10 Number of products per page.
Min value: 1
Max value: 100
Default value: 10
sort_field string N gmv Sort on.
Available values: gmv, units_sold, daily_avg_buyers
Default value: gmv
sort_order string N DESC Sort direction.
Available values: ASC, DESC
Default value: DESC
  • ASC: ascending
  • DESC: descending | currency |string |N |USD |Currency. Available values: USD, LOCAL Default value: LOCAL
  • USD: US dollars
  • LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located | page_token |string |N |cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== |Page token, indicating the current position. Used for requesting next page data. Leave this field empty for first time queries. | start_date_ge |string |Y |2024-09-01 |Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone. In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive) |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202509/shop_videos/752xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx42/products/performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&end_date_lt=2024-09-08&page_size=10&sort_field=gmv&sort_order=DESC&currency=USD&page_token=cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ==&start_date_ge=2024-09-01

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^latest_available_date string 2024-09-07 Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).
^next_page_token string cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== Page token for the next page request. If this value is nonempty, pass it as page_token in the next request and reuse the same video_id, start_date_ge, end_date_lt, sort_field, sort_order, currency, and page_size values. An empty value means that there are no more pages.
^products []object List of product performance metrics.
^^ctr string 0 Ratio of product clicks to product impressions in raw decimal format.
^^customers int 0 Number of customers who purchased the product.
^^daily_avg_buyers string 0 Average number of buyers per day for the current product.
^^gmv object Overall Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for the product.
^^^amount string 0 GMV amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).
^^gpm object Average GMV generated per 1,000 product impressions.
^^^amount string 0 GPM amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD GPM currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^id string 105xxxxxxxxxxxxx247 The ID of the product promoted in the video.
^^name string Product Name The name of the product promoted in the video.
^^product_clicks int 0 Number of product clicks.
^^product_impressions int 0 Number of product impressions.
^^units_sold int 0 Number of units sold for the current product.
^total_count int 10 Total number of products matching the request across all pages.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"latest_available_date":"2024-09-07","next_page_token":"cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ==","products":[{"ctr":"0","customers":0,"daily_avg_buyers":"0","gmv":{"amount":"0","currency":"USD"},"gpm":{"amount":"0","currency":"USD"},"id":"105xxxxxxxxxxxxx247","name":"Product Name","product_clicks":0,"product_impressions":0,"units_sold":0}],"total_count":10},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}

Error Code

For common error codes, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Error Code

Code Message
28001022 invalid request params; detail: start time or end time is invalid.
